# AtroUI Docs

> Dark-first React / Next.js catalog on the official shadcn registry. MIT. You own the copied files.
> Install (shadcn): `npx shadcn@latest add @atroui/home-hero`
> Install (no shadcn): `npx @atroui/cli@latest add home-hero` — same `/r` registry
> Public namespace `@atroui` — https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json — no GitHub token.
> Tailwind CSS v4. Optional Host APIs (`npm i atroui` + BYOK). Site: https://www.atroui.com
> Full catalog dump: https://www.atroui.com/llms-full.txt
> Registry JSON: https://www.atroui.com/r/registry.json
> Repo: https://github.com/atroui/atroui

## Agents

- Paste prompt + rules: https://www.atroui.com/docs/guides/for-agents
- Full catalog dump: https://www.atroui.com/llms-full.txt
- Never import UI from npm `atroui` — registry CLI only.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://www.atroui.com/docs): First-hour Quick Start — init, add a block, essential commands.
- [Installation](https://www.atroui.com/docs/installation): shadcn path + `@atroui/cli`, what lands in the repo, troubleshooting.
- [MCP server](https://www.atroui.com/docs/mcp): Agents search the catalog; returns shadcn + `@atroui/cli` install commands.
- [Coming from…](https://www.atroui.com/docs/migrate): Task paths from plain shadcn/ui, npm atroui, or copy-paste kits.
- [Collections](https://www.atroui.com/docs/collections): Job hubs — forms, OG, launch — instead of browsing every block.

## Setup

- [Registry](https://www.atroui.com/docs/registry): How `@atroui/…` copies source into your repo and how names map.
- [Theming](https://www.atroui.com/docs/theming): Dark-first tokens, Merriweather headings + DM Sans UI, opt-in Caveat sketch.
- [Host APIs](https://www.atroui.com/docs/host-api): Forms and AI routes on your keys — BYOK, 503 when missing.

## Kits

- [Brand kit](https://www.atroui.com/docs/brand): Logo mark, wordmark, and brand voice assets.
- [Identity kit](https://www.atroui.com/docs/identity): Site name, SEO, and identity config.
- [Launch workflow](https://www.atroui.com/docs/guides/launch-workflow): Scope a build through OG social cards.
- [Launch room](https://www.atroui.com/launch): Live Scope → Planner → Social (`npx shadcn add @atroui/launch-workflow`).
- [For agents](https://www.atroui.com/docs/guides/for-agents): Paste prompt + hard install rules for Cursor / Claude / Codex.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://www.atroui.com/docs/glossary): Host API, BYOK, registry, and related terms.
- [Compare](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare): How AtroUI differs from primitives-only / copy-paste kits.
- [Alternatives hub](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/alternatives): Criteria + pick-by-job across kits.
- [AtroUI vs Aceternity UI](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/vs-aceternity): MIT sections + Host APIs vs Pro landing blocks.
- [AtroUI vs Magic UI](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/vs-magic-ui): Soft-rect rooms + BYOK vs animated free effects / Pro sections.
- [Aceternity UI alternative](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/aceternity-alternative): Switch intent — when to pick AtroUI.
- [Magic UI alternative](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/magic-ui-alternative): Switch intent — soft-rect vs spectacle.
- [Tailwind Plus alternative](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare/tailwind-plus-alternative): New Plus sales closed — registry path forward.
- [Changelog](https://www.atroui.com/docs/changelog): Release notes.

### Primitives (highlights)
- @atroui/button, @atroui/card, @atroui/textarea, @atroui/form-select

- @atroui/fade-in, @atroui/stagger, @atroui/scroll-progress

### Blocks (highlights)
- @atroui/home-hero, @atroui/site-header, @atroui/site-footer, @atroui/faq
- @atroui/feature-grid, @atroui/feature-bento, @atroui/logo-cloud, @atroui/logo-marquee
- @atroui/stats-band, @atroui/testimonials-stack, @atroui/cta-band
- @atroui/pricing-overview, @atroui/pricing-tiers, @atroui/auth-split, @atroui/saas-starter
- @atroui/contact-form, @atroui/waitlist-form
- @atroui/og-workspace, @atroui/thumbnail-workspace, @atroui/scope-chat, @atroui/project-planner
- @atroui/launch-workflow — Scope → Planner → OG room + `app/launch/page.tsx`
- @atroui/landing-kit — full soft-rect marketing stack + `app/landing/page.tsx`

### Landing map (Vibrant-shaped)
- Meta: `npx shadcn add @atroui/landing-kit` · live https://www.atroui.com/landing
- Collection: https://www.atroui.com/docs/collections/dark-marketing
- Order: header → hero → logos → bento → stats → testimonials → pricing → FAQ → CTA → footer

## Tools (live rooms)

- [Landing kit](https://www.atroui.com/landing): Vibrant soft-rect marketing stack.
- [Launch room](https://www.atroui.com/launch): Scope → Planner → Social in one path.
- [OG workspace](https://www.atroui.com/og): Generate social cards in the browser.
- [Project planner](https://www.atroui.com/planner): Scope a build, hand off to OG.

- [Blog](https://www.atroui.com/blog): Guides and longer essays.

- Home: https://www.atroui.com
- npm (package `atroui`): https://www.npmjs.com/package/atroui

## Wow primitives

- Install pattern: `npx shadcn add @atroui/<name>` or `npx @atroui/cli add <name>` (same registry).
- [@atroui/marquee](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<Marquee><LogoRow /></Marquee>` — infinite logo/testimonial strip.
- [@atroui/border-beam](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<BorderBeam />` inside a relative card — brand light travelling the edge.
- [@atroui/magic-card](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<MagicCard>` — cursor spotlight + brand border glow on panels.
- [@atroui/animated-beam](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<AnimatedBeam fromRef toRef />` — SVG beam between two nodes.
- [@atroui/bento-grid](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<BentoGrid><BentoCard title description /></BentoGrid>` — soft-rect feature grid.
- [@atroui/meteors](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<Meteors />` at the top of a hero — capped CSS meteor streaks.
- [@atroui/dock](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<Dock><DockIcon /></Dock>` — macOS magnification app dock.
- [@atroui/orbiting-circles](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<OrbitingCircles><Icon /></OrbitingCircles>` — icons orbiting a center node.
- [@atroui/number-ticker](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<NumberTicker value={4800} prefix="$" />` — count-up on inView.
- [@atroui/aurora-text](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): `<AuroraText>Ship in days</AuroraText>` — slow brand gradient sweep on display words.
- Kit: `npx shadcn add @atroui/landing-kit` — `<LandingPage />` composes owned section files (header → footer). Live: https://www.atroui.com/landing
- Starter: `npx shadcn add @atroui/saas-starter` — `<SaasStarter />` announcement + hero + logos + features + stats + pricing teaser + CTA + footer note in one file.
- Optional heroes (not in landing-kit): `@atroui/hero-lamp`, `@atroui/hero-parallax`.
